description: Phone push notifications when tasks, terminal commands, notebook cells, debug sessions or Claude Code finish or need you, through your own ntfy server or ntfy.sh topic. Send your own messages too. No default server, no telemetry.
config.server: URL of your ntfy server, for example `https://ntfy.sh` or `https://ntfy.example.com`. Nightping has no default server and sends nothing until you set this and a topic. An access token, if your server needs one, is set with **Nightping: Set Access Token…** and kept in secret storage, not here.
config.topic: ntfy topic to publish to: letters, numbers, `-` and `_`, up to 64 characters. On a public server anyone who knows the topic can read it, so pick a long, hard-to-guess name or use a server with access control.
config.notifyOn.terminalCommands: Notify when a command in a terminal finishes. Works in terminals with [shell integration](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration).
config.notifyOn.notebookCells: Notify when a notebook cell finishes running.
config.notifyOn.debugSessions: Notify when a debug session ends.
config.notifyOn.claudeCode: Notify when Claude Code finishes a turn, asks you something or waits for your approval. Needs **Nightping: Connect Claude Code…**.
config.notifyOn.codex: Notify when Codex finishes a turn or waits for your approval. Needs **Nightping: Connect Codex…**.
config.minimumDuration: Runs that succeed in less than this many seconds stay quiet. Failures notify at any duration. `0` notifies about every run.
config.onlyWhenAway: Stay quiet while you are using this VS Code window: it is focused and you used it in the last few seconds.
config.content: What a notification says. Everything in it goes to your ntfy server.
config.content.result: The kind of run, its result and duration, for example `Task` / `Failed (exit 1) · 4m 12s`.
config.content.details: Also the task name, command line, notebook file name or debug configuration name.
config.port: Port on `127.0.0.1` where Nightping receives Claude Code's events. After a change, reconnect Claude Code so that its hooks use the new port.
